name: openrouter-copilot-model-manager
description: Browse, filter, and add OpenRouter models to VS Code Copilot Chat with a rich visual interface. Supports pricing display, capability filtering (text/vision/tools), and one-click Copilot integration.

openrouterModelManager.cache.ttlMinutes.description: How many minutes before the model cache is considered stale and automatically refreshed.

openrouterModelManager.requestTimeoutSec.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response from OpenRouter before timing out.

openrouterModelManager.maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed requests (rate limits, server errors).

openrouterModelManager.defaultTemperatur.description: Default temperature for model responses (0.0 = deterministic, 2.0 = creative). Leave empty to use model default.

openrouterModelManager.defaultMaxTokens.description: Default maximum output tokens. Leave empty to use model default.

openrouterModelManager.apiEndpoint.description: OpenRouter API base URL. Change this if using a self-hosted proxy or custom endpoint.

openrouterModelManager.enablePromptCachi.description: Enable OpenRouter automatic prompt caching (cache_control). Dramatically reduces input token costs for Anthropic models in agent mode; ignored by providers that cache automatically.

openrouterModelManager.enableStreamUsage.description: Include stream_options.include_usage in requests to receive token usage statistics. Disable this if you encounter 'invalid_json' errors — some backend providers (Azure, certain OpenAI endpoints) reject this field.

openrouterModelManager.maxInputTokensOve.description: Override the maxInputTokens reported to VS Code for all models. Lower values trigger conversation compaction (summarization of older messages) earlier, preventing oversized request bodies. Leave empty to auto-calculate from each model's context window. Recommended: 200000 for most use cases.

openrouterModelManager.sanitizeBase64Con.description: Strip long base64-like blobs from outgoing prompt text before sending. Prevents OpenRouter organization guardrails from blocking requests with 'prompt injection patterns detected' (base64_encoded_injection) and saves tokens. Image attachments are never affected. Disable if you need the model to analyze raw base64 content.

openrouterModelManager.logLevel.description: Minimum log level for the OpenRouter output channel.
enumDescriptions: Show all messages including debug details
